annotation.title_clean: Kenya AI policy commended for promoting ethical use of artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: Kenya AI policy commended for promoting ethical use of artificial intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Advertising Agency (Kenya); Pili Chimerah, PCO
annotation.summary_en: Kenyan government news item reporting that the Principal Secretary for Science, Research and Innovation commended the Draft Kenya Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies Policy at a youth science exhibition. The draft is in public participation, with comments extended to 11 August 2026. Emphasis is on responsible AI use and digital skills.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft Kenya AI and Other Emerging Technologies Policy is led by the Ministry of ICT and Digital Economy
Public comment deadline extended to 11 August 2026
Policy is described as a framework for safe, responsible and ethical AI development and use
Officials stress youth digital skills and AI education for competitiveness
